# RangeSlider

A single- or dual-thumb slider with tick labels and editable number boxes beside it, for ranges such as BPM 120–130, release years or a minimum connection stre…

`SongNodes.RangeSlider` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.RangeSlider label="…" value={…} onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.RangeSlider" label="…" value="{{…}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (RangeSliderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Group label ("BPM range"). |
| `value` * | `number \| [number, number]` | One value (single thumb) or [low, high] (dual thumb). |
| `onChange` * | `(value: number \| [number, number]) => void` | Called while dragging and on key or box changes. |
| `min` * | `number` | Scale minimum. |
| `max` * | `number` | Scale maximum. |
| `step` | `number` | Arrow-key step; default 1. |
| `bigStep` | `number` | Page Up/Down step; default 10 steps. |
| `ticks` | `number[]` | Tick values to label on the scale (include both ends). |
| `format` | `(v: number) => string` | aria-valuetext and readout formatter ("124 BPM"). |
| `thumbLabels` * | `[string] \| [string, string]` | Accessible names for the thumbs and boxes ["Minimum BPM", "Maximum BPM"]. |
| `help` | `string` | Help text. |
